subject: Post-demo: IR timelines, SOC 2 snapshot & evidence delivery plan
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 15:30:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo: IR timelines, SOC 2 snapshot & evidence delivery plan

Hi Erin and Raj,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps focused on the security/compliance items you flagged:

- You asked for our SOC 2 status and an evidence package for IR/BCP/DR.
- You asked us to kick off the vendor security questionnaire.
- You asked for clarity on breach notification timelines and point(s) of contact.

Immediate requests from our side:
1) Can you confirm the preferred delivery mechanism for sensitive artifacts (SFTP, secure Drive link, or DocuSign access)?
2) Please confirm your breach notification expectation (you mentioned 72 hours during the call; confirm if that is required).
3) We attached a short post-demo deck for context. We have an internal playbook and can produce a redacted IR playbook, BCP summary, and our last DR test report.

Proposed timeline:
- Raj/security team: return the vendor questionnaire (attached) by COB Fri 21 Nov.
- Redwood: deliver initial IR playbook and supporting artifacts by Fri 21 Nov for your review.
- Follow-up call: schedule week of 24 Nov to close outstanding controls items and procurement questions.

Attachments: post-demo-deck.pdf (high-level architecture and tenancy options)

If this all looks good, I will put Marissa and Sean on the thread to assemble the artifacts and agree the transfer method.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0182

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@lumenhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>, LumenHealth Security <security@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: IR timelines, SOC 2 snapshot & evidence delivery plan

Alex,

Thanks for the recap and the deck. A few notes from our side:

- Delivery method: we prefer encrypted SFTP or a shared Drive folder with domain-restricted access. If you use DocuSign for an authorization form, we can accept that too.
- Breach notification: LumenHealth policy requires customer notification within 72 hours of confirmed reportable incidents. If Redwood policy has different windows, please flag now.
- SOC 2: we currently have a SOC 2 Type I report completed in July 2025. Type II is in progress and targeted for completion by March 2026. We can share the Type I report and a controls matrix now (redacted where necessary).

I'll have our security operations team complete the vendor questionnaire you attached. Attaching our version so you have a single file to work from.

Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Security contact for transport and evidence acceptance: security@lumenhealth.com

Best,
Raj Patel
Director, Application Security
Raj.Patel@lumenhealth.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:22:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: IR timelines, SOC 2 snapshot & evidence delivery plan (internal)

Team,

Copying the note from Raj. Key asks to satisfy:
- Provide SOC 2 Type I report and a controls matrix (redacted as needed).
- Assemble an IR evidence bundle: incident response playbook, breach notification templates, and contact escalation lists.
- Provide BCP/DR summary and the most recent test report.
- Confirm we can use encrypted SFTP or Drive with domain-restrictions for delivery; if using DocuSign for an agreement to transfer, okay to route that.

Target internal deadline: EOD Thu 21 Nov so we can share with LumenHealth and get procurement moving.

Sean, can you draft the initial redacted IR playbook and pull DR test report. Marissa, please prepare a short bridge letter that explains schedule for Type II and interim compensating controls. Vanessa, please coordinate secure transfer options and DocuSign if needed.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 13:05:00 -0500
Subject: Initial IR playbook and evidence bundle (redacted)

Erin/Raj,

Per Alex's note and Raj's confirmation on SOC 2 Type I, attaching an initial redacted package for your review. We removed customer-identifying artifacts and internal secrets, but the materials should demonstrate coverage of detection, analysis, containment, eradication, and lessons-learned.

Attachments included:
- IR_Playbook_v1.pdf (redacted operational runbook and RACI)
- BCP_Document.pdf (executive summary of BCP and critical recovery objectives)
- DR-Test-Report-2024.pdf (summary of last tabletop and recovery window metrics)

What these files cover (high level):
- Notification thresholds and internal escalation matrix (examples included)
- Data retention and backup cadence for customer partitions
- Third-party dependencies and fallback regions for Hosted API

A few operational notes and asks from our side:
1) We can deliver additional raw artifacts via encrypted SFTP or by creating a domain-restricted Drive folder. Please confirm preference.
2) We can provide a SOC 2 Type I report and a controls matrix; we are preparing a short bridge letter to explain the Type II timeline and interim compensating controls.
3) We want to confirm LumenHealth's expectation around the 72-hour notification window (policy vs contractual requirement). If 72 hours is contractual, flag that for our legal review.

Secure links: https://drive.google.com/link/to/IR_Playbook_v1
Transfer approval (if requested): https://app.docusign.com/link/to/signature/DL-2025-1174

If you'd like to run a short canary on a non-production tenant to verify access patterns, we can schedule that next week.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Security & Trust (Solutions)
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@lumenhealth.com>, LumenHealth Security <security@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial IR playbook and evidence bundle (redacted)

Sean/Alex,

Thanks for the materials — received and downloading now. A few confirmations and next steps from LumenHealth:

- Delivery method: encrypted SFTP or a Drive folder with domain restriction is acceptable. Please provide credentials/ACL instructions and a contact for the transfer.
- SOC 2: Type I report is acceptable as an interim artifact, but we will need a bridge letter outlining the Type II schedule and any compensating controls.
- Backups: please include a short backup verification statement or a copy of your backup policy for customer partitions.
- Notification window: 72-hour notification is our operational policy and an expectation for procurement. If this will be in the contract, we will treat that as a binding requirement. Please flag if Redwood requires a different contract language.
- Security contact for transfer and evidence intake: security@lumenhealth.com

Can you confirm you can provide the bridge letter and backup verification by COB Thu 27 Nov? Procurement is targeting a completion window by 28 Nov.

Thanks,
Erin Walsh
VP, Procurement & Vendor Risk
erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com
+1 212 555 0199
